parts:
Hello

I am trying to execute this code in shiny

URL1 <- paste("https://www.googleapis.com/fusiontables/v2/query?sql=SELECT col0 FROM ",ConfigTable,"&key=",APIKey,sep="")
paste(readLines(URL1), collapse="")
and then using fromJSON to convert to dataframe
